name: wp-ai-translate
description: Editor assets for the AI Translate plugin.

scripts.build: npm run build:editor-panel && npm run build:post-links && npm run build:language-switcher && npm run build:overview
scripts.build:overview: wp-scripts build src/overview/index.js --output-path=wp-ai-translate/build/overview && npm run build:overview-css
scripts.make-pot: node extract-js-i18n.mjs /tmp/wpait-js.pot && wp i18n make-pot wp-ai-translate wp-ai-translate/languages/wp-ai-translate.pot --exclude=build,node_modules --merge=/tmp/wpait-js.pot
